header.title: How to Use a Blender to Grind Coffee
header.description: This guide explains how to use a standard blender to grind coffee beans, covering setup, grind size selection, the grinding process, cleaning, and finally, making your coffee.

steps.description: Place the blender on a flat counter surface and plug it in to ensure stability.
actions: Put blender on a flat surface
Plug it in

steps.description: Determine the appropriate grind size for coffee beans based on the type of coffee maker being used.
actions: Decide on coffee maker type (Drip, Espresso, or French Press).
Assess grind texture for Drip maker: some grounds should stick together, most should fall away.
Assess grind texture for Espresso maker: most grounds should stick together, individual grounds visible.
Assess grind texture for French Press maker: grounds should not stick together.

steps.description: Grind coffee beans using a blender, starting with a small amount and monitoring the yield.
actions: Start with a small amount of beans in the blender
Figure out how much ground coffee your beans will yield
Determine the right amount of coffee beans to put into your blender
Consider screwing on a Mason jar to the grinding attachment of your blender
Put your coffee beans in the Mason jar
Attach the Mason jar to the blade attachment
Screw the blade attachment onto your blender base
Make sure the blender top is firmly on
Start the blender on the pulse setting
Turn it off every ten seconds if no pulse setting is available
Do not put your hand in the blender while it is in use

steps.description: This step details how to clean the blender by detaching the blade, rinsing the body, and washing the blade and top.
actions: Twist the blade attachment off the blender body.
Rinse the blender in the sink.
Wash the blade attachment by hand.
Wash the blender top by hand.
Pay extra attention when you wash the blade attachment, so you do not get cut.
steps.part: blade attachment, blender body, blender top

steps.description: Add coffee grounds to the coffee maker's filter and proceed with the usual coffee-making process.
actions: Pour coffee grounds
Insert coffee grounds into filter
Follow normal procedure for making coffee
Enjoy
